hints.text: Keep multiplying by $5$ and see how many fives it takes to reach $625$.
The powers of five run $5, 25, 125, 625$. Count how many fives were multiplied to reach the last one.
Four fives are needed, so $5^4 = 625$ and $x = 4$.

explanation: To match the bases, write $625$ as a power of $5$.
Multiplying four fives together gives $5 \times 5 \times 5 \times 5 = 625$, so $625 = 5^4$.
Now the equation reads $5^x = 5^4$, and equal bases force equal exponents, so $x = 4$.

alternativeExplanations.title: Ask the log question
steps: The equation is the same as $x = \log_5(625)$.
A log asks: $5$ to what power gives $625$?
